parent_objective: design sensitivity/projection probe for contour-aware exact objective
blocked_by: M1634 shows direct base update is not meaningful because base residual is zero

public_gates: M1635 must design sensitivity/projection semantics only
M1635 must account for zero base residual
M1635 must define base versus controlled-perturbation checks
M1635 must keep diagnostics and donor-plus action guardrails intact
M1635 must keep actor update PPO promotion and private holdout blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a sensitivity/projection probe before any objective-only update
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no actor update, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if probe cannot distinguish base zero residual from perturbed candidates
stop if controlled perturbation would violate checkpoint or promotion discipline
stop if diagnostics or donor-plus guardrails would be used as positive targets
stop before implementation and route to audit or synthesis as needed
fallback_plan: admit bounded sensitivity implementation if design is clean
pivot to objective design repair if zero residual makes probe uninformative
route to branch synthesis if another narrow implementation would exceed cadence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1634 admits sensitivity/projection probe design instead of direct actor update

admission_evidence: M1634 audit found base residual is zero and direct base update is uninformative
allowed_updates: M1635 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits sensitivity implementation, repair, synthesis, or stop
next_stage_criteria: implementation admission or fallback is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1635 designs objective sensitivity checks only and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must preserve correct/wrong hidden branch checks and later closed-loop intervention requirements
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If sensitivity design is uninformative, record the zero-residual blocker and pivot before implementation.
allowed_claims: sensitivity/projection probe design over public exact objective
no actor update, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The zero-residual exact evaluator can be turned into a useful retention/projection test by comparing the base checkpoint with controlled perturbed candidates.
success_criteria: design defines base and controlled-perturbation checks
design defines sensitivity metrics and stop rules
design states supported and unsupported claims
actor update PPO promotion and private holdout remain blocked
failure_criteria: design treats diagnostics or donor-plus actions as positive targets
design routes directly to PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes
design claims paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
decision_rule: M1635 passes if it designs a bounded sensitivity/projection probe and keeps update/training blocked.
